title: Driver
description: Driver coaching: one lap against a reference lap, by distance around the track. Reads the session and laps picked at the top, not the dashboard time range.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) UNION SELECT current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) v WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (vehicle_id = current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) DESC NULLS LAST, 1
list.query: SELECT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) UNION SELECT current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) v WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (vehicle_id = current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) DESC NULLS LAST, 1
list.description: Opens on the vehicle this pit is deployed for (OPENLAPS_VEHICLE_ID); any other vehicle with data in the time range can be picked.

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
list.definition: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
list.description: Every session this vehicle has laps in, newest first, whatever the time range. Opens on the newest.

list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.query: SELECT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') GROUP BY driver ORDER BY driver
list.definition: SELECT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') GROUP BY driver ORDER BY driver
list.description: Drivers with laps in the selected session.

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.query: SELECT concat('Lap ', session_lap, ' - ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' - ', concat(floor((lap_time_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((lap_time_s) - 60 * floor((lap_time_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')), CASE WHEN NOT clean THEN ' (not clean)' ELSE '' END) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND lap_time_s IS NOT NULL AND lap_time_s < 600 AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') ORDER BY crossed_at DESC
list.definition: SELECT concat('Lap ', session_lap, ' - ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' - ', concat(floor((lap_time_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((lap_time_s) - 60 * floor((lap_time_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')), CASE WHEN NOT clean THEN ' (not clean)' ELSE '' END) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND lap_time_s IS NOT NULL AND lap_time_s < 600 AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') ORDER BY crossed_at DESC
list.description: The lap to study. Newest first; opens on the latest lap.

list.name: lap_ref
list.label: Reference
list.query: SELECT __text, __value FROM (SELECT 'Fastest clean lap of the session' AS __text, 'best' AS __value, 0 AS ord, 0::double precision AS t UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (driver) concat('Fastest by ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ': ', concat('Lap ', session_lap, ' - ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' - ', concat(floor((lap_time_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((lap_time_s) - 60 * floor((lap_time_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')), CASE WHEN NOT clean THEN ' (not clean)' ELSE '' END)), lap_id::text, 1, lap_time_s FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND lap_time_s IS NOT NULL AND lap_time_s < 600 AND clean ORDER BY driver, lap_time_s) d UNION ALL SELECT concat('Lap ', session_lap, ' - ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' - ', concat(floor((lap_time_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((lap_time_s) - 60 * floor((lap_time_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')), CASE WHEN NOT clean THEN ' (not clean)' ELSE '' END), lap_id::text, 2, -extract(epoch FROM crossed_at) FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND lap_time_s IS NOT NULL AND lap_time_s < 600) o ORDER BY ord, t
list.definition: SELECT __text, __value FROM (SELECT 'Fastest clean lap of the session' AS __text, 'best' AS __value, 0 AS ord, 0::double precision AS t UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (driver) concat('Fastest by ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ': ', concat('Lap ', session_lap, ' - ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' - ', concat(floor((lap_time_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((lap_time_s) - 60 * floor((lap_time_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')), CASE WHEN NOT clean THEN ' (not clean)' ELSE '' END)), lap_id::text, 1, lap_time_s FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND lap_time_s IS NOT NULL AND lap_time_s < 600 AND clean ORDER BY driver, lap_time_s) d UNION ALL SELECT concat('Lap ', session_lap, ' - ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' - ', concat(floor((lap_time_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((lap_time_s) - 60 * floor((lap_time_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')), CASE WHEN NOT clean THEN ' (not clean)' ELSE '' END), lap_id::text, 2, -extract(epoch FROM crossed_at) FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND lap_time_s IS NOT NULL AND lap_time_s < 600) o ORDER BY ord, t
list.description: What to compare it with: the session's fastest clean lap, a driver's fastest, or any lap.

panels.title: The two laps
panels.description: The lap picked at the top, and the reference it is compared with. Blue is the lap and orange the reference in every panel below. To reference is the lap time difference: plus means the lap was slower.

targets.rawSql: WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, track_name, session_lap, driver, lap_start_at, crossed_at, lap_time_s, clean FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session'), picked AS (SELECT 'Lap' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = '$lap' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reference' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = CASE WHEN '$lap_ref' = 'best' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM laps WHERE clean ORDER BY lap_time_s LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap_ref' END) SELECT which AS "Which", concat('Lap ', session_lap) AS "Lap of the session", COALESCE(driver, '-') AS "Driver", concat(floor((lap_time_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((lap_time_s) - 60 * floor((lap_time_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')) AS "Lap time", CASE WHEN which = 'Lap' THEN to_char(lap_time_s - (SELECT lap_time_s FROM picked WHERE which = 'Reference'), 'SG990.000') END AS "To reference (s)", crossed_at AS time FROM picked ORDER BY which

panels.title: The lap against the reference, around the track
panels.description: Speed, running time lost, accelerator pedal, brake and gear for the lap (blue) and the reference (orange), stacked on one distance axis and labelled with the track's sections; corners are shaded. Move across any chart and the line follows on all of them, with one readout. Drag across a chart to zoom them all to that stretch of track; the reset button at the top right, or the bar at the bottom, zooms back out. The map on the right draws both laps' lines from the car's GPS: a dot on each shows where the crosshair is, the readout says how far left or right of the reference the lap ran, and the map zooms to the same stretch as the traces. Point at the map to move the crosshair to that place. Time lost rising means losing time there. Brake is the share of each 10 m with the pedal switch on: where and how long, not how hard. Section names need the track's sections loaded (tools/track_sections.py); without them the axis reads metres.

targets.rawSql: WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, track_name, session_lap, driver, lap_start_at, crossed_at, lap_time_s, clean FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session'), picked AS (SELECT 'Lap' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = '$lap' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reference' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = CASE WHEN '$lap_ref' = 'best' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM laps WHERE clean ORDER BY lap_time_s LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap_ref' END), grid AS (SELECT p.which, p.lap_start_at, v.* FROM picked p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT time_bucket('100 ms', s.time) AS t, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'timing.distance') AS dist, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'timing.lap_elapsed') AS elapsed, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'position.speed') AS speed, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'car.accel_pedal_pos') AS pedal, max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'car.brake_pedal_switch') AS brake, max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'car.gear') AS gear FROM v_samples_named s WHERE s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND s.channel IN ('timing.distance', 'timing.lap_elapsed', 'position.speed', 'car.accel_pedal_pos', 'car.brake_pedal_switch', 'car.gear') AND s.time > p.lap_start_at - interval '30 seconds' AND s.time <= p.crossed_at GROUP BY 1 OFFSET 0) v), filled AS (SELECT which, lap_start_at, t, dist, elapsed, speed, pedal, max(brake) OVER (PARTITION BY which, brake_run) AS brake, max(gear) OVER (PARTITION BY which, gear_run) AS gear FROM (SELECT *, count(brake) OVER w AS brake_run, count(gear) OVER w AS gear_run FROM grid WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY which ORDER BY t)) g), pts AS (SELECT * FROM filled WHERE t >= lap_start_at AND dist IS NOT NULL), bins AS (SELECT which, floor(dist / 10) * 10 AS bin, avg(speed) AS speed, avg(pedal) AS pedal, avg(brake) * 100 AS brake, max(gear) AS gear, avg(elapsed) AS elapsed FROM pts GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT bin AS "Distance", max(speed) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap') AS "Speed", max(speed) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference') AS "Speed ref", max(pedal) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap') AS "Pedal", max(pedal) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference') AS "Pedal ref", max(brake) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap') AS "Brake", max(brake) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference') AS "Brake ref", max(gear) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap') AS "Gear", max(gear) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference') AS "Gear ref", max(elapsed) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap') - max(elapsed) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference') AS "Time lost" FROM bins GROUP BY bin ORDER BY bin

WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, track_name, session_lap, driver, lap_start_at, crossed_at, lap_time_s, clean FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session'), picked AS (SELECT 'Lap' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = '$lap' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reference' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = CASE WHEN '$lap_ref' = 'best' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM laps WHERE clean ORDER BY lap_time_s LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap_ref' END), lap_m AS (SELECT v.m FROM picked p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(s.value) AS m FROM v_samples_named s WHERE s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND s.channel = 'timing.distance' AND s.time > p.lap_start_at AND s.time <= p.crossed_at OFFSET 0) v WHERE p.which = 'Lap') SELECT t.name AS "Section", t.kind AS "Kind", t.start_fraction * lap_m.m AS "From", t.end_fraction * lap_m.m AS "To" FROM v_track_sections t, lap_m WHERE t.track_name = (SELECT max(track_name) FROM picked) ORDER BY t.seq

WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, track_name, session_lap, driver, lap_start_at, crossed_at, lap_time_s, clean FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session'), picked AS (SELECT 'Lap' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = '$lap' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reference' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = CASE WHEN '$lap_ref' = 'best' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM laps WHERE clean ORDER BY lap_time_s LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap_ref' END) SELECT p.which AS "Which", v.dist AS "Distance", v.lat AS "Lat", v.lon AS "Lon" FROM picked p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT time_bucket('40 ms', s.time) AS t, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'timing.distance') AS dist, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'position.lat') AS lat, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'position.lon') AS lon FROM v_samples_named s WHERE s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND s.channel IN ('timing.distance', 'position.lat', 'position.lon') AND s.time > p.lap_start_at AND s.time <= p.crossed_at GROUP BY 1 OFFSET 0) v WHERE v.dist IS NOT NULL AND v.lat IS NOT NULL AND v.lon IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.which, v.t

panels.title: Grip used (g-g)
panels.description: Each point is a tenth of a second: cornering g across, braking (down) and acceleration (up). A fuller, rounder shape means more of the tyre is being used, especially braking and turning at once.

targets.rawSql: WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, track_name, session_lap, driver, lap_start_at, crossed_at, lap_time_s, clean FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session'), picked AS (SELECT 'Lap' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = '$lap' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reference' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = CASE WHEN '$lap_ref' = 'best' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM laps WHERE clean ORDER BY lap_time_s LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap_ref' END), grid AS (SELECT p.which, p.lap_start_at, v.* FROM picked p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT time_bucket('100 ms', s.time) AS t, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'timing.distance') AS dist, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'fused.accel_lat') AS lat, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'fused.accel_long') AS lon FROM v_samples_named s WHERE s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND s.channel IN ('timing.distance', 'fused.accel_lat', 'fused.accel_long') AND s.time > p.lap_start_at - interval '30 seconds' AND s.time <= p.crossed_at GROUP BY 1 OFFSET 0) v), filled AS (SELECT * FROM grid), pts AS (SELECT * FROM filled WHERE t >= lap_start_at AND dist IS NOT NULL) SELECT lat AS "Lateral g", lon AS "Lap" FROM pts WHERE which = 'Lap' AND lat IS NOT NULL AND lon IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t

WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, track_name, session_lap, driver, lap_start_at, crossed_at, lap_time_s, clean FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session'), picked AS (SELECT 'Lap' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = '$lap' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reference' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = CASE WHEN '$lap_ref' = 'best' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM laps WHERE clean ORDER BY lap_time_s LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap_ref' END), grid AS (SELECT p.which, p.lap_start_at, v.* FROM picked p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT time_bucket('100 ms', s.time) AS t, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'timing.distance') AS dist, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'fused.accel_lat') AS lat, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'fused.accel_long') AS lon FROM v_samples_named s WHERE s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND s.channel IN ('timing.distance', 'fused.accel_lat', 'fused.accel_long') AND s.time > p.lap_start_at - interval '30 seconds' AND s.time <= p.crossed_at GROUP BY 1 OFFSET 0) v), filled AS (SELECT * FROM grid), pts AS (SELECT * FROM filled WHERE t >= lap_start_at AND dist IS NOT NULL) SELECT lat AS "Lateral g", lon AS "Reference" FROM pts WHERE which = 'Reference' AND lat IS NOT NULL AND lon IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t

panels.title: Corner by corner
panels.description: Each marked section of the lap, from the track map loaded with tools/track_sections.py. Speeds are km/h on the way in, at the slowest point and on the way out, for the lap and (ref) for the reference. Time lost is the lap's time through the section less the reference's, to a tenth of a second; red is where the lap gave time away. Empty until sections are loaded for this track.

targets.rawSql: WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, track_name, session_lap, driver, lap_start_at, crossed_at, lap_time_s, clean FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session'), picked AS (SELECT 'Lap' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = '$lap' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reference' AS which, * FROM laps WHERE lap_id::text = CASE WHEN '$lap_ref' = 'best' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM laps WHERE clean ORDER BY lap_time_s LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap_ref' END), grid AS (SELECT p.which, p.lap_start_at, v.* FROM picked p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT time_bucket('100 ms', s.time) AS t, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'timing.distance') AS dist, avg(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'position.speed') AS speed FROM v_samples_named s WHERE s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND s.channel IN ('timing.distance', 'position.speed') AND s.time > p.lap_start_at - interval '30 seconds' AND s.time <= p.crossed_at GROUP BY 1 OFFSET 0) v), filled AS (SELECT * FROM grid), pts AS (SELECT * FROM filled WHERE t >= lap_start_at AND dist IS NOT NULL), lap_m AS (SELECT which, max(dist) AS lap_m FROM pts GROUP BY which), sec AS (SELECT s.seq, s.name, s.kind, p.which, count(*) * 0.1 AS secs, min(p.speed) AS v_min, (array_agg(p.speed ORDER BY (p.dist / m.lap_m < s.start_fraction), p.t))[1] AS v_in, (array_agg(p.speed ORDER BY (p.dist / m.lap_m < s.start_fraction) DESC, p.t DESC))[1] AS v_out FROM v_track_sections s JOIN lap_m m ON true JOIN pts p ON p.which = m.which AND p.speed IS NOT NULL AND ((s.start_fraction <= s.end_fraction AND p.dist / m.lap_m >= s.start_fraction AND p.dist / m.lap_m < s.end_fraction) OR (s.start_fraction > s.end_fraction AND (p.dist / m.lap_m >= s.start_fraction OR p.dist / m.lap_m < s.end_fraction))) WHERE s.track_name = (SELECT max(track_name) FROM picked) GROUP BY s.seq, s.name, s.kind, p.which) SELECT name AS "Section", round((max(secs) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap') - max(secs) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference'))::numeric, 1) AS "Time lost (s)", round(max(v_in) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap')) AS "Entry", round(max(v_in) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference')) AS "Entry ref", round(max(v_min) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap')) AS "Minimum", round(max(v_min) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference')) AS "Minimum ref", round(max(v_out) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap')) AS "Exit", round(max(v_out) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference')) AS "Exit ref", round(max(secs) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Lap')::numeric, 1) AS "Time (s)", round(max(secs) FILTER (WHERE which = 'Reference')::numeric, 1) AS "Time ref (s)" FROM sec GROUP BY seq, name ORDER BY seq
